choice.body: Automatic updates are recommended. During public beta, Preview receives eligible test releases. Portcove verifies updates and waits for a safe exit or an explicit restart before applying them.
choice.title: Choose how Portcove updates

notice.availableBody_preview: Preview update found ({{size}}). Review it in Settings before downloading.
notice.availableBody_stable: Stable update found ({{size}}). Review it in Settings before downloading.
notice.readyBody_preview: Preview update verified ({{size}}). Review it in Settings and restart when convenient.
notice.readyBody_stable: Stable update verified ({{size}}). Review it in Settings and restart when convenient.

outcome.repairedApplyNoDownload: Pending update request cleared. No verified download is currently available.
outcome.repairedApplyWithDownload: Pending update request cleared. The verified download remains available.
outcome.repairedStaging: Damaged update download deleted. Download the update again.
outcome.resetDamaged: Damaged update settings reset. No choice is saved, and automatic application update checks remain off.
outcome.resetPreferences: Update preferences reset. Automatic checks remain off until you save a new choice.
outcome.saved: Update settings saved. Saving these settings does not start an update.
outcome.saveFailedRefreshed: {{error}} Current settings were refreshed; review them before saving again.

preferences.automaticUnavailable: Automatic isn't available because this build can't install its own updates. Install updates through your package manager or the manual instructions; Portcove can still check and notify you.
preferences.channelDescription_preview: Preview receives public test releases and later eligible final releases.
preferences.channelDescription_stable: Stable waits for an eligible production release that is newer than your installed version; it never downgrades Portcove.
preferences.modeDescription_automatic: Allows Portcove to check and stage verified updates without asking for each release. Applying still waits for a safe exit or an explicit Restart to update action.
preferences.modeDescription_manual: Does not check automatically. Use Check for updates when you want to look for a release.
preferences.modeDescription_notifyOnly: Checks for eligible updates and tells you when one is available. Downloading and applying require explicit actions.
preferences.noChoice: No application update choice is saved. Automatic checks remain off until you save one.
preferences.pauseDescription: Stop automatic checks and all downloads until resumed. Manual checks remain available.
preferences.resetDisclosure: Reset update preferences clears your saved choice and turns off automatic checks until you choose again.
preferences.savedDefault_preview: Saved default: Preview. Changes below apply after saving; they do not change the check above.
preferences.savedDefault_stable: Saved default: Stable. Changes below apply after saving; they do not change the check above.
preferences.saveDoesNotStart: Saving these settings does not start an update.
preferences.title: Future update behavior

productionTransition.body: Stable is recommended and waits for an eligible production release newer than this installation; it never downgrades Portcove. Keep Preview to continue receiving eligible test releases. Your update mode and pause setting stay unchanged.
productionTransition.title: Choose an update channel

status.applyDescription: Portcove checks that it can safely install the update before replacing the app.
status.description: See the download, restart request, and installer state.
status.idle: No verified application update is staged.
status.installerFailedRefresh: The installer couldn't finish the update. Refresh update status to review the next available action.
status.installerFailedRetry: The installer couldn't finish the update. Try Restart to update again.
status.installerSucceeded: The installer reported success. Reopen Portcove to confirm the installed version and application health.
status.launchFailedRefresh: The installer didn't start. Refresh update status to review the next available action.
status.launchFailedRetry: The installer didn't start. Try Restart to update again.
status.launchStarted: The installer started, but Portcove has not confirmed the update. Reopen Portcove to check the installed version.
status.launchStarting: Portcove cannot confirm whether the installer started. Reopen Portcove to check the installed version before another update attempt.
status.noSuccess: No successful application update check is recorded.
status.recoveryApplyDescription: Clear only the pending request. This does not delete a verified download.
status.recoveryApplyTitle: The pending update request needs repair
status.recoveryScheduleDescription: Reset check timing and retry history. Your update settings stay unchanged.
status.recoveryStagingDescription: Delete the damaged download. You will need to download and verify it again.
status.repairIncomplete: Repair did not complete. Review Activity and refresh the current state.
status.restartNote: Restart to update will check package ownership and other installation requirements again.
status.restartUnconfirmed: Restart was not confirmed. Review Activity and refresh the current state.
status.restrictionDeb: This DEB installation is managed by its package manager. Update it through the same package source.
status.restrictionNotConfigured: This build cannot update itself. Follow the manual upgrade instructions for your package.
status.restrictionRepairApply: Repair the pending update request before trying again.
status.restrictionReviewPending: Review the pending request or installer result below before another restart.
status.restrictionRpm: This RPM installation is managed by its package manager. Update it through the same package source.
status.restrictionUnavailable: This installation cannot update itself. Follow the manual upgrade instructions for your package.
status.stagedSummary_preview: Portcove {{version}} (Preview, {{size}}) has been downloaded and verified.
status.stagedSummary_stable: Portcove {{version}} (Stable, {{size}}) has been downloaded and verified.
status.terminationCrash: Portcove closed unexpectedly. Refresh update status before trying again.
status.terminationNormalExit: Portcove closed normally. Refresh update status before trying again.
status.terminationOsShutdown: The computer shut down. Refresh update status before trying again.
status.terminationRestartToApply: Portcove closed to apply the update. Refresh update status before trying again.
status.terminationSteamStop: Steam stopped Portcove. Refresh update status before trying again.
status.terminationUnknown: Portcove couldn’t confirm how the app closed. Refresh update status before trying again.
status.title: Update activity
status.waitingCloseTitle: Update requested. Waiting for Portcove to close.
status.waitingRestartTitle: Update requested. Waiting for Portcove to restart.
